profile.headline: Sr. Graphics Software Engineer at CNN
profile.summary:
I'm a strange combination of artist / programmer / physicist. Though these trades may seem radically different they actually work exceedingly  well side by side.
Art has given me the ability to find and understand creative solutions to most problems. It has also given me the confidence not to be fearful of a white canvas or a blank page.
Programming has giving me the skills to trouble shoot difficult problems and find the easiest and simplest solution. 
And science has given me a sharp mind and the tools necessary to find and be driven by facts.

positions.title: Viz designer/ programmer
positions.description: Started in Telefutura creating Viz content for shows like Contacto Deportivo and Noche de Perros. In August 2012 I took charge of all VizRT graphic content for Univision Deportes Network. This includes Creating new content for shows and games, up keeping and updating all current graphics, creating easy to work with user interfaces for all graphics (for Viz trio and INEWS). And anything else my superiors might want from the Viz.

positions.description: Worked with Maya, Cinema 4D, photoshop and after effects to create graphic content for different shows in Telefutura. I personally mostly worked for the shows Contacto Deportivo and Noche de Perros.

projects.title: Popup SDLP
projects.description: Software defined live productions are productions that go to our streaming platforms and use cloud/html graphic engines and switchers. Designed to be spun up at a moments notice and not take resources from or interfere with the main live broadcast.

projects.title: ESPN Innovation Competition
projects.description: I ended as a finalist, top 16, in the 2022 ESPN innovation competition. The work presented was the gymnastics dashboard used by collegiate control rooms.
